requirement: The system shall allow operators to select processes and handler programs and start process tracing through a command-line tool.
The system shall trace application function calls using Linux eBPF probes and support loading default handlers and process-specific handlers for tracing sessions.

The system shall capture syscall, file, and network events for traced processes and deliver them from kernel space to userspace through a perf-based event channel. Events shall include a common leading section that enables the userspace tracer to dispatch them.
The system shall generate eBPF handler source code from Proto/JSON event configuration, using the configured events and their argument metadata.
The system shall operate on Linux kernels with eBPF, kprobe, and kretprobe support and remain compatible with the gobpf integration used for tracing.
